partition_decision: Explicit user authorization 2026-10-05: 2022-04-11 through 2026-09-25 including 2024-2025 are seen development in v2; no historical independent outer OOS. Prior sealed manifests and ledgers remain untouched.
historical_outer_oos: NONE; 2024-2025 previously seen, development only in v2

walk_forward.training: rolling prior 365 calendar days; two chronological inner validation halves; every evaluation, mutation context and survivor selection at origin cut off strictly before outer development test interval; freeze selection before test; no replay of later mutations on prior tests
walk_forward.continuity: one portfolio; carry cash, quantities and episode state across adjacent folds; strategy state reinitialized only when selected genes change; gaps rejected; no hidden cash reset
walk_forward.regimes: calendar folds frozen before scoring; bull/bear/sideways coverage must be reviewed before activation; never select boundaries from winners
walk_forward.outer_independence: development walk-forward scores are selection evidence, not sealed final test

metrics.primary_cagr: (last_equity/initial_equity)^(365.25/elapsed_calendar_days)-1; prior-close initial timestamp, final-close terminal timestamp
metrics.mdd: close equity peak to trough, include initial equity; continuous primary plus each fold
metrics.concentration: dominant positive log contribution / net log growth; null when net growth nonpositive or no positive contribution; never impute zero
metrics.attribution: daily asset PnL reconciles NAV; log contributions reconcile total growth; named whole episodes carry across folds; open terminal episodes marked OPEN and never claimed closed
metrics.no_top3: remove log contributions of top three positive CLOSED whole episodes; if fewer than three, metric null and INCONCLUSIVE
metrics.no_best_day: remove best positive daily log contribution, keep calendar duration

execution.fill: next daily open; long-only historical spot proxy, not venue certified
execution.double_cost: double fee, slippage and borrow debits
execution.delayed_entry: one additional daily open for exposure increases; exits remain next open; cancel stale entry on intervening exit
execution.production_reference: offline canonical authorized target decisions, never imported PnL; historical BASE is a composite sleeve, resolved only from same-date phase67j_no_neo_main_paper.csv::executed_position when executed_regime=BASE and chosen_asset empty; CASH underlying gives zero risky exposure, retain original target/exposure/source lineage; unresolved BASE fails; all targets applied at following open
execution.benchmark_parity: all references and candidates same execution engine, period, cost and fill assumptions

invalid_reference_policy: Run every reference. Missing held-asset execution/mark price makes the entire requested metric UNDEFINED_INVALID, not zero, truncated CAGR or invented liquidation. Preserve failure date/asset. Valid production and BTC controls required before evolution; invalid legacy hypothesis explicitly rejected rather than blocking unrelated valid trials.
checkpoint_serialization: native JSON scalars and integer cooldown keys; serialization-only fixes require explicit append-only binding migration, identical equity/metrics proof for all existing completed evaluations, no deletion, same cycle ID

evolution.dedup: global gene hash within v2; completed evaluation bound to engine, contract, input and stress; v1 re-evaluation explicitly versioned
evolution.inheritance: survivors membership in next generation, same immutable evaluation reused; valid Pareto only, diagnostic fallback explicitly labeled
evolution.origin_audit: separate deepseek/deterministic candidate counts, eligibility, paired parent deltas, gain per evaluation and provider token; no advantage asserted without evidence
evolution.api_policy: phase2_broker_policy.json; compact context only, durable reservations, content cache and unknown billing protection
